actors_and_users b3b2750b9205.sql:
SELECT event_name, substr(col, 6) AS a, attr_value,
			count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS n, count(DISTINCT user_id), count(*) FROM (
			UNPIVOT (SELECT event_name, actor_id, user_id, COLUMNS('^attr_') FROM product WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10')
			ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME col VALUE attr_value)
			GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY event_name, a, n DESC, attr_value

c93e5dcace04.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev2 Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Key:secret Action:block To: CreatedAt:}]}
c93e5dcace04.sql:
-- Every attribute the project's events carry, one attr_<key> column each,
-- turned into (key, value) rows; the `$` keys (environment, location) are
-- typed columns rather than attributes, and the Views dashboard has them.
-- "attr_$" is a column no key can name, there so the unpivot has one when
-- no event ever carried an attribute; it is NULL, and the unpivot drops
-- NULLs. The COLUMNS pattern takes actor_id too: one that matched nothing
-- would be an error.
--
-- One row per (attribute, value) over the whole range: Count is the events
-- that carried the value, Users the distinct actors who sent it and Groups
-- the distinct groups (0 when none), both exact for the range. There is no
-- Day column: a year of per-day values is millions of rows nobody reads,
-- and one attribute's trend over time is a chart's job.
--
-- No DISTINCT aggregate: DuckDB cannot spill one, and a year at the cap
-- holds millions of (attribute, value, actor) triples. The events are first
-- folded into one row per actor, group and set of values (an actor sends
-- the same values again and again), then grouped by (attribute, value) and
-- actor and, apart, by (attribute, value) and group: plain GROUP BYs, which
-- spill; each actor's or group's row then counts once.
--
-- The table is remote, so the viewer's filters, sort and page run over
-- every row in SQL.
WITH folded AS (
  SELECT COLUMNS('^(actor_id|attr_.*)$'), nullif(group_id, '') AS group_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS "attr_$",
         count(*) AS events
  FROM product
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
  GROUP BY ALL
),
a AS (
  UNPIVOT folded ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME attr_key VALUE attr_value
),
per AS (
  SELECT attr_key, attr_value, actor_id, group_id, GROUPING(actor_id) AS by_group, sum(events) AS events
  FROM a
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((attr_key, attr_value, actor_id), (attr_key, attr_value, group_id))
)
SELECT substr(attr_key, 6) AS "Attribute", attr_value AS "Value",
       CAST(sum(events) FILTER (WHERE by_group = 0) AS BIGINT) AS "Count",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE by_group = 0) AS "Users",
       count(group_id) FILTER (WHERE by_group = 1) AS "Groups"
FROM per
GROUP BY attr_key, attr_value
ORDER BY "Attribute", "Count" DESC, "Value"

product_attributes ce3223c38764.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev2 Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Key:secret Action:block To: CreatedAt:}]}
product_attributes ce3223c38764.sql:
WITH a AS (
  UNPIVOT (
    SELECT COLUMNS('^(day|event_name|actor_id|group_id|attr_.*)$'),
           nullif(app_locale, '') AS "attr_$app_locale",
           nullif(app_version, '') AS "attr_$app_version",
           nullif(browser, '') AS "attr_$browser",
           nullif(browser_locale, '') AS "attr_$browser_locale",
           nullif(browser_version, '') AS "attr_$browser_version",
           nullif(country, '') AS "attr_$country",
           nullif(device, '') AS "attr_$device",
           nullif(device_model, '') AS "attr_$device_model",
           nullif(host, '') AS "attr_$host",
           nullif(kind, '') AS "attr_$kind",
           nullif(os, '') AS "attr_$os",
           nullif(os_version, '') AS "attr_$os_version",
           nullif(path, '') AS "attr_$path",
           nullif(platform, '') AS "attr_$platform",
           nullif(referrer_source, '') AS "attr_$referrer",
           nullif(utm_campaign, '') AS "attr_$utm_campaign",
           nullif(utm_medium, '') AS "attr_$utm_medium",
           nullif(utm_source, '') AS "attr_$utm_source"
    FROM product
    WHERE project_id = 1 AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
  )
  ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME col VALUE attr_value
)
SELECT day, event_name, substr(col, 6) AS attr_key, attr_value, count(*) AS "count",
       count(DISTINCT actor_id) AS unique_users, count(DISTINCT group_id) AS unique_groups
FROM a
GROUP BY day, event_name, col, attr_value
ORDER BY day, "count" DESC, event_name, attr_key, attr_value
